title: Instrumention gap hunt: KV-evictions not visible in console dashboards
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Summary: During a capacity regression on 2026-01-29 we observed elevated tail latency and several tenants experiencing degraded console graphs. The incident postmortem identified that KV-eviction events and per-tenant eviction counters were not consistently emitted to our metrics pipeline for a subset of runtime hosts. Two contributing problems were discovered: (1) an opportunistic sampling filter in the trace/metrics ingestion layer dropped eviction-related spans when ingress volume exceeded a threshold, and (2) multiple dashboard panels relied on a derived metric that is populated only when the eviction path takes the hot code path (rare at low pressure), resulting in dashboards showing misleading zeros during the regression. This ticket tracks follow-ups to close the blind spots, update dashboards, and prevent silent degradation in future capacity events.
comments: 2026-02-06 - Aisha Khatri: Initial triage attached to incident-2026-01-29. Identified mismatch between span tag keys used by runtime and keys expected by ingestion mapper. Created quick dashboard snapshot showing host vs tenant visibility.

2026-02-07 - Marco Ruiz: Reproduced sampling drop locally by simulating ingress burst. Confirmed eviction span sampling rate funnels spans to low-priority path and then dropped. Created draft PR to increment eviction span priority and add a compact metric emission as fallback.

2026-02-09 - SRE Review (Jin Park): Agreed to widen ingestion filter for eviction-related spans but requested guardrails to avoid cardinality explosion. Added review note to PR for metric label constraints.

2026-02-11 - Design (Lena Ortiz): Dashboard iteration: replace derived-zero panels with direct eviction-counter panels and add a heatmap for per-tenant tail-latency correlated with eviction spikes. Shared prototype in Figma.

2026-02-12 - Marco Ruiz: Dependency PRs opened for runtime metric emission and ingestion mapping. End-to-end test harness added to CI to simulate eviction storms and verify metrics reach Grafana and traces link to request IDs.
action_items: A1: Add a compact eviction_counter metric emitted on the fast path in runtime (low-cardinality labels). Owner: Marco. Estimate: 3 pts. Due: 2026-02-18.

A2: Adjust sampling rules in ingestion pipeline to give eviction and KV-eviction spans a higher sampling weight with explicit cardinality whitelist. Owner: Jin Park (SRE). Estimate: 2 pts. Due: 2026-02-15.
A3: Replace misleading derived panels in Console dashboards with direct eviction_counter panels and add tenant heatmap. Owner: Lena Ortiz (Design) + Marco. Estimate: 3 pts. Due: 2026-02-22.
A4: Add an automated canary: periodic eviction-heartbeat synthetic that triggers metric flow and alerts if missing for >10m. Owner: SRE. Estimate: 2 pts. Due: 2026-02-20.
A5: Update incident runbook to include checks for eviction counters, sampling drops, and derived-metric fallbacks. Owner: On-call doc owner. Estimate: 1 pt. Due: 2026-02-12.
A6: Create CI chaos test to generate eviction pressure and assert metrics and traces are preserved end-to-end. Owner: Marco. Estimate: 5 pts. Due: 2026-03-05.
A7: Post-deploy validation: schedule a 72-hour observation window and run a dashboard integrity report to confirm coverage across regions. Owner: Observability team. Estimate: 1 pt. Due: 2026-03-01.
